facts.text: The hotel is in Msheireb Downtown Doha, steps from Souq Waqif and Msheireb Metro Station.
facts.excerpt: Park Hyatt Doha Hotel is a luxury retreat in the Heart of Doha, steps from Souq Waqif and Msheireb Metro Station.

facts.text: Sora Rooftop is a Japanese restaurant serving sushi, tempura and robata, set 21 storeys above Msheireb Downtown.
facts.excerpt: Perched 21 storey's above Msheireb Downtown, Sora provides panoramic views of The Doha Palace, Green Mosque, Souq Waqif, Corniche and Doha skyline.

facts.text: Sora Rooftop serves small sharing dishes, sushi, tempura and robata grilled over charcoal.
facts.excerpt: With a balance of small sharing dishes, sushi, tempura and the unique culinary art of Robata (meat grilled over charcoal)

facts.text: Sora Rooftop serves a brunch on Fridays.
facts.excerpt: The cuisine is best enjoyed over Sora Rooftop Brunch, adding a flair of excitement to your Fridays in Qatar.

facts.text: Opus is the hotel's Mediterranean all-day dining restaurant with an open show kitchen and a wood-fired oven.
facts.excerpt: A lively open show kitchen with a wood fired oven will set the stage for an interactive dining experience.

facts.text: Opus is a Mediterranean restaurant.
facts.excerpt: Opus is a Mediterranean restaurant that serves a diverse array of delectable dishes inspired by the flavors of the Mediterranean coast.

facts.text: Anis is an all-day healthy eatery with gluten-free options and alfresco dining on Sikkat Wadi.
facts.excerpt: An all-day, healthy food eatery offering delicious, hand-made, nutritionally-balanced food (including gluten-free options), coffees, juices and smoothies.

facts.text: Anis offers alfresco dining on Sikkat Wadi.
facts.excerpt: Anis additionally offers alfresco dining on Sikkat Wadi, perfect for enjoying the milder weather during Doha's winter months

facts.text: The Spa spans two floors and has mood showers, a hot tub, sauna, steam room and ice room.
facts.excerpt: Spanning two floors, The Spa at Park Hyatt Doha is a destination dedicated to restoration and well-being. Guests are invited to experience a curated journey through tailored treatments, mood showers, a hot tub, sauna, steam room and ice room.

facts.text: The semi-covered pool and fitness center have dedicated spaces for women and men, with year-round swimming and views across Msheireb Downtown.
facts.excerpt: Featuring dedicated spaces for women and men, high-end cardio and strength equipment and year-round swimming with views across Msheireb Downtown

facts.text: All rooms have floor-to-ceiling windows, window seats and a marble bathroom with deep soaking tub, rain shower and double vanity.
facts.excerpt: All rooms enjoy floor to ceiling windows, luxury window seats, and designer marble bathroom with deep soaking tub, rain shower, and double vanity sink.

facts.text: Rooms have Le Labo bath toiletries and a Nespresso coffee maker.
facts.excerpt:
Le Labo bath toiletries
  - Nespresso coffee maker

facts.text: The Presidential and Diplomat Suites have a private terrace with views over the city or Corniche.
facts.excerpt: Presidential and Diplomat Suite guests can retreat to a private terrace with magnificent views over the city or Corniche.

facts.text: The Family Park Suite has one king room and one twin room plus a living room and large dining table.
facts.excerpt: Our spacious 130 square-meter Family Suite offers one king and one twin room.

facts.text: Valet parking is complimentary for hotel guests and event visitors.
facts.excerpt: We offer valet for hotel guests and event visitors.

facts.text: Hamad International Airport is 14.2 kilometers from the hotel.
facts.excerpt: Hamad International Airport (DOH)14.2 kilometers

facts.text: In-room dining is available 24 hours.
facts.excerpt: Our 24-hour in-room dining service offers an exquisite selection of freshly prepared dishes

facts.text: The hotel has a 297-square-meter pillarless ballroom.
facts.excerpt: Host a lavish gala in our 297-square-meter pillarless ballroom

facts.text: Souq Waqif is 0.65 kilometers from the hotel.
facts.excerpt:
Souq Waqif

0.65 Kilometers away

facts.text: The Presidential Suite has an Arabesque design and a terrace overlooking the Corniche, Souq Waqif and the Museum of Islamic Art.
facts.excerpt: The exquisite suite features an inspired Arabesque design

facts.text: The Salon offers hair and nail treatments.
facts.excerpt: A curated selection of premium hair and nail treatments is delivered with thoughtful care
